title: The faction's Builder flies home to Node Beta Industrial Station, the build site, once (Logistics)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 12:38 UTC (orders ENT-087 P3, P4 and block APOLLO: the kit assembled as parts arrive, the builds at Node Beta and Central Nexus; rule F8). At 12:35 UTC the Builder waited docked at Alpha Centauri with every route of its list closed (why_closed.py): its far routes are fenced by skills_below corporation_management 7 so it stays near the build sites (skill logistics-stock step 33). This route takes it home once (requires.role builder); at Node Beta the docked carbon buy for the reserve (buy-carbon-reserve-node-beta, in_system node_beta) gives it work without a jump. once: one trip per pilot; standing: judged by the work it opens, never by its own pay.
